title: Feasibility of the deep learning method for estimating the ventilatory threshold with electrocardiography data.
summary: A deep-learning model estimated ventilatory threshold from single-lead ECG in 260 cardiovascular patients and was compared with cardiopulmonary exercise testing. This is a measurement-feasibility result in the reported cohort, not evidence of interchangeable clinical decisions.
ai_technology: A deep neural network mapped single-lead ECG signals to ventilatory-threshold estimates.
